rules.sentence: Differential diagnoses of patent foramen ovale include atrial septal defect and small patent ductus arteriosus.[33]

Evidence suggests that closure of a patent foramen ovale may decrease the risk of decompression illness in divers with patent foramen ovale who have previously experienced decompression sickness.[20][31][32]
The paradox of PFO and diving is that it is seldom discovered in a diver until they experience a DCS incident that suggests right-to-left bubble shunting; the diver is then tested for PFO.
